context:
Goal: No price change reaches buyers without a live read first.
Problem (money): /push and /publish are not slash commands. They are two web addresses on banchi's server that move a price upload live with only a confirm and no live read. Nothing in the repo calls them now, but they still answer, so a stray request could change a live price.
Based on (read): banchi server/capture_server.py still routes both (_MARKDOWN_PUSH_RE, _MARKDOWN_PUBLISH_RE). The app's pushMarkdown and publishMarkdown in app/src/server.ts have no caller. No script, CLI, Makefile or workflow calls either address. Only harness test t7/send_markdown.py calls the two handlers directly (main 0657163, read 2026-11-03 18:25 CST).
Based on (read): the one press, POST .../send in server/send_routes.py, reads what is live, then pushes and publishes.
Based on (notes): A caller outside the repo, such as a hand-typed request, is unmeasured.
Departs from: D273 says the one press is the only route that publishes, and the server answers three — the two unused addresses are deleted, or kept with a live read.
home: banchi D273 (one press sends listings live)

options.gain: One door to the live price, and it reads live first; D273 is true.
options.how: A lane removes the two routes, their handlers (do_markdown_push, do_markdown_publish), the two uncalled app functions, their rows in scripts/screen-freshness.mjs, the t7 cases that call the handlers, and the lines in docs/specs/stale-listings.md.
options.label: Delete both addresses
options.lose: A hand-typed request to either address stops working; none was found in the repo.

options.gain: An outside caller, if one exists, keeps working.
options.how: Record both addresses in D273 and add the live read to each handler.
options.label: Keep as a second door
options.lose: Two doors to guard and keep right, for callers nobody found.

ref: deep audit 1102, banchi homes; coordinator handoff/audit-child-questions 9d97c9b, oq-publish-route
title: banchi: Delete the two unused publish addresses, or keep them with a live read?
